name: Aletheore
description: Evidence-grounded repository audits: a free deterministic CLI scanner plus a hosted GitHub App with automated PR reviews, dead code detection, live endpoint health monitoring, AIRview (an AI-generated architecture map), and Slack/Teams alerts.

offers.name: Aletheore Flash
offers.description: Automatic PR reviews on every push, powered by $5 of AI credit a month (about 400 PRs), one model.

offers.name: Aletheore AIR
offers.description: Up to 3 team members, $18 of AI credit a month. Everything in Flash plus managed audits, and AIRview builds run on DeepSeek.

featureList: Deterministic secret, vulnerability, and license scanning across 13 languages
Dead code detection from real call-graph analysis
Local semantic code search via vector index
Multi-provider AI audit reports (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama)
GitHub App: automatic PR comments and branch-protection check runs
AI-powered managed audit reports on pull requests, written by DeepSeek
Automatic Flash reviews on every pull request push (Flash tier and up); AIR adds more AI credit, AIRview, Docs and managed audits
Live API endpoint health monitoring across multiple targets, with a public status API
AIRview: an AI-generated, always-current map of your repo's architecture with dependency diagrams
AI-generated Docs: grounded, per-symbol descriptions written and kept current automatically, marked AI-generated or AI-polished, exportable as a single Markdown file
Team seat management, up to 3 seats included on Aletheore AIR
